title: 骨龙系列 · 64×64 像素样品
subtitle: 独立图标：64×64｜下图为 4 倍像素放大预览
mode: imagegen built-in, then nearest-neighbor export to 64x64
prompt_common: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one Minecraft Java item sprite for a bone-dragon RPG series. The attached image is a STYLE AND THEME REFERENCE only, not an edit target. Draw only the single requested item, isolated on a fully transparent canvas. Match the ivory bone, charcoal/blue-gray metal, and small cyan soul-fire accents of the reference. IMPORTANT: design on a logical 64 by 64 pixel grid and present it as a clean nearest-neighbor enlargement; crisp square pixel clusters and hard pixel stair-step edges, no antialiasing, blur, soft glow, grain, or tiny painterly marks. A detailed but readable vanilla-inspired pixel sprite with deliberate 1-pixel outlines, bone cracks and bevels, 12-20 restrained colors. Center the full item with a 4-logical-pixel transparent safety margin. No text, labels, frame, shadow on the background, UI, or extra objects.

assets.name: 断翼斩龙剑
assets.prompt_detail: One diagonal greatsword, handle bottom-left and point top-right. An ivory segmented dragon-wingbone blade with two small backward bone barbs, dark slate grip and guard, a narrow cyan channel near the blade core, clear pointed cutting edge. Preserve the familiar Minecraft sword pose, not a staff.

assets.name: 葬骨龙骑盔
assets.prompt_detail: One front-facing wearable helmet icon, not a creature portrait. Ivory dragon-skull brow and two short swept-back horns, dark slate cheek guards, a black T-shaped face opening, small cyan eyes. Clearly read as a compact equippable helmet.

assets.name: 葬骨龙骑胸铠
assets.prompt_detail: One front-facing symmetrical chestplate icon with shoulder guards and waist. Ivory rib bones laid over charcoal-blue armor, sculpted bone sternum, a tiny cyan soul-heart gem at the center, restrained cracks. The silhouette must unmistakably read as Minecraft chest armor.

assets.name: 葬骨龙骑腿铠
assets.prompt_detail: One single front-facing pair of armored leggings, not a whole character. Dark blue-slate leg plates, ivory segmented dragon-bone thigh and knee guards, small worn cracks, a bone belt, two clearly separated legs. Familiar Minecraft leggings icon silhouette.

assets.name: 葬骨龙骑战靴
assets.prompt_detail: One single pair of front-facing armored boots together as one inventory icon. Dark blue-slate boots with ivory wraps and angular skeletal dragon toe plates, a few short side bone spurs, clean readable soles. Familiar Minecraft boots icon silhouette; not legs or a character.

assets.name: 骨龙獠牙
assets.prompt_detail: One single curved skeletal dragon fang, diagonal from its thick ivory broken root at the upper right to a long tapered sharp point at lower left. Detailed warm bone ridges and a few thin cracks, dark slate outline. No metal, no handle, no extra fragments. Clearly a crafting ingredient.

assets.name: 万骨甲壳
assets.prompt_detail: One single roughly oval broken carapace plate made from fused dragon ribs. Three ivory bone ridges arch over a dark blue-slate base, cracked irregular edges, a tiny cyan soul-fire seam. This is a loose crafting fragment, not wearable chest armor.

assets.name: 碎裂翼骨
assets.prompt_detail: One single broken dragon wingbone fragment as a crafting ingredient, diagonal. A long ivory bone with a jointed end, rough splintered break and visible bone grain/cracks, 2-3 small loose chips nearby, strong compact silhouette. No flesh, no skin, no wings or whole dragon.

assets.name: 怨火龙心
assets.prompt_detail: One single compact soul-fire dragon-heart crafting ingredient. A dark blue-slate heart core surrounded by an ivory rib cage, cyan soul-fire peeking between the bones, and only 2-3 small solid cyan flame tongues above it. Crisp pixels with no hazy glow or smoke. Clearly heart shaped, no background.
